from enum import StrEnum
from pathlib import Path
import json


class OrderStatus(StrEnum):
    DRAFT = "draft"
    SUBMITTED = "submitted"
    FULFILLED = "fulfilled"


def is_terminal(status: OrderStatus) -> bool:
    return status == "fulfilled"


def format_pipeline(raw: str) -> str:
    step1 = raw.strip()
    step2 = step1.lower()
    return step2


def save_order(path: Path, order_id: str, status: OrderStatus) -> None:
    payload = {
        "order_id": order_id,
        "status": str(status),
    }
    path.write_text(json.dumps(payload))


def load_order(path: Path) -> dict:
    data = json.loads(path.read_text())
    return {
        "order_id": data["order_id"],
        "status": data["status"],
    }
